desc: Port the old engine's slope-based triplanar cliff sampling into splat_terrain_ps.hlsl: replace the cliff SampleGrad at tiledUV (both g_CliffAlbedo and g_CliffNormal) with triplanar projection of world position (AnchoredPos + g_Anchor) using weights pow(abs(normalize(In.WorldNormal)), 4.0) (normalized). Use plain Sample (constant-Jacobian uvs are fine with the REPEAT/aniso g_DetailSampler). Keep the normal blend in existing tangent space (nT); leave wCliff blends and sand/snow/splat lines byte-identical. Leave the sand/snow/splat chain untouched. No comments in code. Note the shader is loaded from the pak: scripts/build.sh repacks changed paks, so no separate data step is needed.

Rebuild and run headless (./scripts/build.sh then the game with ENGINE_HIDDEN_WINDOW=1, VK_ICD_FILENAMES=radeon icd, and ENGINE_AUTOTEST=enter so the capture lands on the world, not the main menu); confirm runtime shader compilation succeeds (no glslang errors for the cliff triplanar sample) and the scene renders.
